opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Training Opportunities Under 18s

deadlines.raw: Awards will run for three years, starting from 1 September 2025.

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence the delivery of outstanding quality teaching within their field.
opportunities.summary: Support for arts training for school-age children under 18 outside of regular school hours, e.g. for weekends or evenings or during holiday periods.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Art Scholarship Bursaries for Undergraduates and Postgraduates
opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Bursaries for Undergraduates and Postgraduates

deadlines.raw: Applicants can apply for bursaries to start in one, two or each of the three years of the award period: 2025, 2026 and 2027.

amount.raw: Bursaries of £5,000 to £10,000 a year per student.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions that can demonstrate outstanding quality teaching within their particular field and who offer degrees at either undergraduate or postgraduate taught level.
opportunities.summary: Support to provide bursaries for outstanding undergraduate and/or postgraduate students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year one, and £28,000 in years two and three.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Support for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

deadlines.raw: Applications must be submitted by 18 February 2027.

amount.raw: A minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post.
opportunities.summary: Support for senior researchers to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

deadlines.raw: The Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships are now open for submission in March 2026.

amount.raw: Up to £5 million for 18 four-year scholarships at UK/home rates and 6 four-year scholarships at international/overseas rates.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities that hold research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funding for up to 30 Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area for that institution.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers in any discipline with an established track record and who have been prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research.
opportunities.summary: Funding for experienced researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

deadlines.raw: The closing date falls in May each year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who have been prevented by routine duties from undertaking or completing a programme of original research.
opportunities.summary: Support for experienced researchers to complete a piece of research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem.
opportunities.summary: Support for talented early career scholars to develop and demonstrate research leadership.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education, or UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis.
opportunities.summary: Funding for researchers to undertake an innovative and original research project.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

deadlines.raw: Applications must be submitted by 18 February 2027.

amount.raw: A minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers, or some specialist arts institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research.
